final_message:
The deviation report is finished: it finds 36 conflicts and omissions (7 Critical, 10 High, 11 Medium, 8 Low), and the file passes validation and opens and reads back correctly. The biggest are Preferred Stock designated beyond what the charter authorizes (26.65M vs 25M), an over-allotment option of 1.5M shares in the prospectus vs 1.725M in the underwriting agreement, a capitalization rep that counts options as outstanding shares, an Exhibit A that is the old pre-IPO charter, dilution figures that don't tie to the capitalization table, and a lock-up form that runs from the wrong date.
